title: Planet Tweaks V3.5.2 - IQON Bento Dashboard, Mouse Input Fix, Curated Themes & Full Overhaul
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.5.2 (2026-11-20): (1) IQON Bento Dashboard: Redesigned 3-column bento layout with GPU sensor-aware N/A handling, real 28-sample purple network waveform, thermal zone stub rejection, and friendly power plan readout. (2) Mouse Input & Lifecycle Fixes: Fixed double MOUSEEVENTF_*UP injection and physical-click hold cancellation race in FastInputService, cleaned up Anti-Ghosting WH_MOUSE_LL hooks & Latency Lab timers on navigation/close, enforced single WndProc hook registration, and added ChronoBlock 0.500ms auto-lock persistence. (3) Curated 14-Theme Studio & Sidebar Polish: Kept Deep Solix Blue, Mocha Brown, Lagoon Blue, and Polar Daylight plus new Dark, Bright, and DarkxBright split-contrast themes with collapsible Custom Palette Studio, smooth 240<->48px sidebar fold animation, 3.5s tooltip delay, Windows Tools sub-tabs (Utilities | My PC | Health Center), parallel App Optimizer, and hardened SafetyPolicy & truthful offline/DNS cloud status.
